title: Settlement of the Budget Billing Deferred Balance
content:
# Settlement of the Budget Billing Deferred Balance

**Rule.** Where a Budget Billing plan settles its deferred balance annually, the bill that carries the plan's annual settle-up settles the deferred balance when its absolute value is at least the plan's settle-up minimum: a positive balance is billed and a negative balance is credited. On removal, withdrawal and service closure every plan settles its whole deferred balance under the plan's settlement terms for removal, for withdrawal or for service closure. Each kind of settlement is settled once per date.

## Two occasions of settlement

| Occasion | Plans concerned | What is settled | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Annual settle-up | Plans that settle the deferred balance annually | The deferred balance | Absolute value at least the plan's settle-up minimum; a smaller balance carries over |
| Removal for missed installments | Every plan | The whole deferred balance, under the plan's removal settlement terms | None beyond the removal |
| Voluntary withdrawal | Every plan | The whole deferred balance, under the plan's withdrawal settlement terms | None beyond the withdrawal |
| Closing of the service agreement | Every plan | The whole deferred balance, under the plan's service closure settlement terms | None beyond the closure |

## Direction of a settlement

| Deferred balance at settlement | Settlement |
|---|---|
| Positive — actual charges have run beyond the installments | Billed to the customer |
| Negative — installments have run beyond actual charges | Credited to the customer, in its absolute value |

A settlement is dated on the bill date of the bill that carries it, and the deferred balance it settles is reduced to nothing by it.

## Once per date

A settlement of a given kind — the annual settle-up, or a settlement on removal, withdrawal or closure — is booked once for a given date. A second settlement of the same kind dated the same day is not booked.

## Basis Q&A

**On a plan without an annual settle-up, is the balance ever settled?** Yes — on removal, withdrawal or closure of the service agreement, every plan settles its whole deferred balance, under its own settlement terms for that occasion.

**Does the settle-up minimum apply when a plan ends?** No. The minimum governs the annual settle-up; on removal, withdrawal and closure the whole deferred balance is settled.

**Hypothetical.** A Residential Budget Billing Plan holds a deferred balance of $6.40 in the customer's favour on its anniversary-month bill: below the $10.00 minimum, it carries over. The customer withdraws two months later with the balance at $31.80 owed: the whole $31.80 is billed under the plan's withdrawal settlement terms.
